name: @avatark/world-persistence-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 9's durable persistence mechanics: deterministic catch-up (reusing @avatark/living-systems-runtime's own advanceWorldSimulation unmodified), checkpoint creation/recovery, lifecycle transitions, HOT/WARM/COLD resource-tier mapping, and reference in-memory adapters for optimistic concurrency, idempotent event append, and world-execution leasing. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/tickPolicy.test.ts src/catchUp.test.ts src/checkpoint.test.ts src/recovery.test.ts src/lifecycle.test.ts src/inMemoryDurableRepositories.test.ts src/leaseRepository.test.ts src/multiVisitorMultiInstance.test.ts src/livingForestPortability.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
